items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I also met a guy named Robert Cummins, who had a record company called India Navigation. And I had caught his eye.

ctx.x: When was the first time you got to record?

That’s kind of interesting. I kind of recorded three albums almost simultaneously. It was a little unusual. The ACAM, which is the Association for the Advancement of Creative Musicians, had garnered some attention from the Japanese in Chicago, and there were some Japanese record companies that were coming over and recording a lot of that, Muhal was doing records and Henry and everyone. And they had caught, I had caught their eye as well. And there was a guy, he came over, and I was in New York. Actually when I…
Can you describe what you were doing at that time?
